shortDescription: Manage event streams in EDA Controller

options.name: controller_host
options.description: The URL of the EDA controller. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_HOST), or E(AAP_HOSTNAME) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_HOSTNAME) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password used for authentication. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD), or E(AAP_PASSWORD) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_PASSWORD) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: controller_token
options.description: Token used for authentication. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_TOKEN), E(AAP_TOKEN), or E(AAP_OAUTH_TOKEN) environment variables will be used. Support for E(CONTROLLER_TOKEN), E(AAP_TOKEN), and E(AAP_OAUTH_TOKEN) has been added in version 2.10.

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username used for authentication. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME), or E(AAP_USERNAME) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_USERNAME) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: credential_name
options.description: The name of the credential. The type of credential can only be one of ['HMAC Event Stream', 'Basic Event Stream', 'Token Event Stream', 'OAuth2 Event Stream', 'OAuth2 JWT Event Stream', 'ECDSA Event Stream', 'mTLS Event Stream', 'GitLab Event Stream', 'GitHub Event Stream', 'ServiceNow Event Stream', 'Dynatrace Event Stream']

options.name: event_stream_type
options.description: Type of the event stream. This field is not necessary to create an event stream and will be ignored. This field will be removed in version 3.0.0.

options.name: forward_events
options.description: Enable the event stream to forward events to the rulebook activation where it is configured.

options.name: headers
options.description: Comma separated HTTP header keys that you want to include in the event payload. To include all headers in the event payload, leave the field empty.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Setting this option will change the existing name (lookup via name).

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for the connection with the EDA controller. If not set, the value of C(CONTROLLER_TIMEOUT), E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT) environment variables will be used. Support for E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT) has been added in version 2.7.

options.name: uuid
options.description: Custom UUID for the event stream URL. If not provided, UUID will be auto-generated. Must be unique across all event streams.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to Ansible Automation Platform EDA Controller instance. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL), or E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS). Support for E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS) has been added in version 2.7.
